topic: User-Defined Structs and Initialization in C++
explanation: In C++, structs are user-defined data types that group together variables under a single name, enabling organized data management. Modern C++ extends the utility of structs by supporting constructors, member functions, and initialization techniques, making them integral to object-oriented programming. Proper understanding of struct declaration and initialization is essential for designing complex data structures and leveraging C++'s type system effectively.
keywords: C++ struct, struct initialization, user-defined type C++, aggregate initialization
